name: @vanillawc/wc-arrow
description: Configurable decorative arrows for diagrams and directional indicators; length, width, head shape and rotation are adjustable.

name: @vanillawc/wc-blink
description: Wraps text or inline content in a blinking effect. Use sparingly for attention indicators.

name: @vanillawc/wc-bullet-chain
description: Presents list items as a connected chain of bullet points, useful for timelines and progress narratives.

name: @vanillawc/wc-datepicker
description: Adds a keyboard-accessible calendar to a slotted text input, with configurable date formats, locale labels and initial dates.

name: @vanillawc/wc-icon-rule
description: A horizontal divider with an icon or other decorative content; supports custom icon dimensions and rule styling.

name: @vanillawc/wc-marquee
description: An animated scrolling banner for text or other content, including optional party effects.

name: @vanillawc/wc-markdown
description: Renders Markdown content with optional syntax highlighting; useful for rich text and documentation panels.

name: @node-projects/chart-js-webcomponent
description: Wraps Chart.js for data visualizations. Configure chart data and options through the documented component properties.

name: @node-projects/tab.webcomponent
description: A tab container for dividing child content into separate selectable panels.

name: @node-projects/gauge.webcomponent
description: Numeric gauge visualizations: double, CSS and material gauges. Some additional gauge ports in the repository are work in progress.
notes: Only list manifest-confirmed gauge components as available; README marks other ports WIP.

name: @node-projects/input-knob
description: A touch-sensitive rotary numeric input with value, minimum, maximum and turn scale; emits knob-move-start/change/end events.

name: @node-projects/hsluv-webcomponent
description: A color selector based on HSLuv, wrapping the HSLuv library and its reference color-picker interface.
notes: Use the manifest export tag node-projects-hsluv; the README component-name list is inconsistent.

name: @node-projects/wired-elements
description: A collection of sketch-style controls and layout widgets: buttons, inputs, toggles, sliders, cards, tabs, dialogs and progress indicators. Calendar uses a separate entry point.
notes: Use the scoped node-projects fork. wired-calendar requires its explicit module import.

name: @node-projects/sweethome3d-webcomponent
description: A 3D home/floor-plan viewer wrapping Sweet Home 3D JS Viewer. Requires a home model URL; it is a viewer rather than a floor-plan editor.
notes: The model and related resources must be accessible to the browser.

name: @node-projects/imask-webcomponent
description: A text-entry control using IMask patterns for formatted and constrained input.

name: @node-projects/automatic-slidershow-webcomponent
description: An automatic slideshow component for cycling through content or images.

name: @node-projects/color-wheel.webcomponent
description: Color-wheel controls, including a complex color wheel, for interactive color selection.
notes: Repository README contains a stale tab-control description; the demo and manifest identify color-wheel components.

name: @node-projects/luma-elements
description: Home-automation controls, device cards, charts, layouts and entity-detail popups. Includes lights, thermostats, covers, media, energy views, tanks, clocks and state images. Supports light/dark/system themes. Receives data and emits actions; host code must connect ioBroker bindings and commands.
notes: Not yet published when checked on 2026-11-10; registry returned 404. Publication is expected shortly. Retry installation after publication; do not substitute a Git URL or invent a version. Theme CSS is a separate package export. Host handles backend communication.

name: @stefanjudis/sparkly-text
description: Adds animated sparkles around text; supports sparkle count, size and color customization.

name: @christianliebel/paint
description: Embeds a Paint-style drawing application with browser-native file/clipboard features where supported. Use paint-app for the complete application.
notes: Some browser capabilities require permission or a secure context. Do not execute file operations while designing.

name: vanilla-colorful
description: Lightweight accessible color-picker elements supporting multiple color models; color changes are delivered through component events.

name: @zachleat/hypercard
description: Adds a three-dimensional tilt/hover treatment to card content, with configurable scale, perspective and glow; respects reduced-motion preferences.

name: emoji-picker-element
description: An emoji selection widget with search, custom emoji, localization, light/dark styling and emoji-click events. Emoji data is cached with IndexedDB; consider offline data provisioning.

name: @zachleat/snow-fall
description: Adds a snowfall animation over a page or wrapped element, with configurable flake count, color, size and text; respect reduced-motion preferences.
